summary: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. filed a routine Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, attaching a press release announcing an Investor Day to be held in New York on September 17, 2026. Brookfield Asset Management's session runs 12:45-2:45 p.m. ET, followed by Brookfield Corporation's 3:00-5:00 p.m. ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing merely provides webcast and replay details. For a US-equivalent read, it corresponds to an ordinary investor-day scheduling announcement. Nothing here is a special situation; there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
